name: hy-mt2-local-bilingual-v1
description: 64 distinct fixed English/Chinese texts. Alternating directions keep the first 32 balanced. Synthetic examples for throughput and smoke checks, not translation-quality scores.

cases.text: The railway station has moved its information desk to the ground floor while the main hall is being renovated. Passengers who need help changing a reservation should follow the blue signs near the eastern entrance. The ticket machines will remain available throughout the construction period, and staff will provide additional assistance during the evening rush hour.
小区图书角将于下周六重新开放，新增的书架主要用于存放儿童绘本和科普读物。居民可以凭借登记卡借阅图书，每次最多借三本，借期为两周。管理员提醒大家，如果发现书页破损，请在归还时说明情况，便于志愿者及时修补。

Our engineering team reduced the size of the installation package by removing duplicate resources and compressing optional examples. Existing projects will continue to open normally after the update. If you maintain a custom extension, please check its compatibility in a test environment before distributing the new version to the rest of your organization.
研发团队发现，某些旧版本的配置文件包含重复字段，可能导致应用启动时读取错误的默认值。新的迁移工具会先创建备份，再合并能够安全处理的重复项。无法自动判断的内容将被列入报告，由维护人员检查后决定是否修改。

The museum's latest exhibition follows the development of coastal navigation from hand-drawn charts to satellite positioning. Visitors can compare historical instruments, listen to recorded interviews with sailors, and examine a restored lighthouse lens. Guided tours begin at ten in the morning, but the interactive gallery remains open until the museum closes.
这次城市摄影展以普通人的日常生活为主题，展示了清晨的菜市场、雨中的公交站和深夜仍然亮着灯的修车铺。策展人希望观众关注照片中细小的动作与表情，因为这些看似平常的细节，往往比宏大的场景更能体现一座城市的温度。

A sudden change in wind direction forced the outdoor concert to begin half an hour later than planned. The organizers moved several speakers and secured the temporary roof before allowing the audience to enter. Although the opening act performed a shorter set, the musicians added an extra song at the end of the evening.
由于连续降雨，原定于周日上午举行的社区运动会将延期一周。已经报名的队伍不需要重新提交材料，但如果队员名单发生变化，请在周三之前联系组织者。场地入口处会公布新的比赛顺序，工作人员也会通过短信发送提醒。

Please place the fragile glass samples in separate compartments and record the temperature before sealing the transport container. The receiving laboratory needs both the shipment number and the collection date to match each sample with its documentation. If the protective material becomes wet, replace it before the package leaves the building.
仓库将在月底进行库存盘点，盘点期间暂停办理非紧急出库。各部门应提前确认下个月第一周的物料需求，并核对领料单上的规格、数量和项目编号。对于包装破损或标签不清晰的货物，保管员会单独登记，避免与正常库存混放。

The coastal village used to rely almost entirely on fishing, but younger residents have started several small businesses that serve visitors. One family turned an unused workshop into a bakery, while another offers walking tours of the old harbor. These changes have created new jobs without removing the public spaces that local residents value.
山村里的旧粮仓经过改造，成了一间供游客和村民共同使用的咖啡馆。屋顶保留了原来的木梁，墙上挂着当地学生拍摄的四季风景。经营者说，他们希望这里不仅能吸引游客，也能成为年轻人回乡后交流想法、寻找合作机会的地方。

The revised schedule leaves a twenty-minute break between the workshop and the panel discussion. Participants may use this time to visit the demonstration area or submit questions through the event website. Speakers should arrive at the preparation room at least fifteen minutes before their session so that technicians can check the presentation files.
本次研讨会采用线上和线下结合的方式进行，远程参会者可以通过会议页面提交问题。为了保证讨论时间，每位报告人的发言控制在十五分钟以内。主持人会在最后五分钟举牌提醒，并将尚未回答的问题整理后发送给相关专家。

The recipe works best when the vegetables are cut into pieces of roughly equal size. Cook the onions slowly until they become soft, then add the tomatoes and stir for another minute. Keep a little hot water nearby so that you can adjust the consistency of the sauce without interrupting the cooking process.
制作这道汤时，先将洗净的蘑菇切成薄片，再用少量油炒出香味。加入温水后转为小火，煮十分钟左右即可。出锅前可以根据个人口味加入胡椒和葱花，但不宜过早放盐，以免掩盖食材本身清淡的味道。

The customer reported that the replacement keyboard arrived on Tuesday, but the parcel did not include the cable listed on the packing slip. Please confirm the missing item's part number and arrange a separate shipment. There is no need to ask the customer to return the keyboard if all of its keys are working correctly.
您好，我们已经收到您关于订单包装损坏的反馈。为了尽快确认情况，请提供外包装和商品标签的照片，并说明商品是否能够正常使用。客服人员会根据检查结果安排补发配件或换货，并在处理完成后向您发送新的物流信息。

Researchers compared soil samples from three gardens that had used different watering methods for an entire growing season. They measured moisture at several depths and recorded how quickly the surface dried after irrigation. The results suggest that local soil conditions matter more than the total amount of water applied on any single day.
研究人员在三块试验田中种植了相同品种的作物，并分别采用不同的覆盖材料。他们每周记录土壤温度、含水量和植株高度，持续观察了整个生长季。初步结果显示，覆盖方式对幼苗阶段的影响较大，但后期差异还需要结合降雨情况分析。

The software keeps an activity log so that administrators can determine when a setting was changed and which account made the change. Sensitive values are omitted from the log, while the names of the affected settings remain visible. The retention period can be adjusted separately for development, testing, and production environments.
系统会在每次同步之前检查文件的修改时间，并优先处理发生变化的内容。如果网络连接中断，尚未完成的任务会保留在队列中，等待恢复后继续执行。用户也可以在状态页面查看失败原因，并手动重试指定文件，而不必重新同步整个目录。

When the afternoon train finally arrived, Maya noticed that the platform was quieter than she remembered. The small flower stall was still there, but its wooden sign had been repainted a bright green. She paused beside it for a moment, trying to decide whether the town had changed or whether she had simply been away too long.
傍晚的风从河面吹来，带着一点潮湿的凉意。老人把藤椅往屋檐下挪了挪，继续听收音机里断断续续的戏曲。巷口忽然传来熟悉的脚步声，他没有回头，只是慢慢放下手里的茶杯，说了一句：“路上还顺利吧？”

The new bicycle route connects the university campus with the riverside park. Most of the path is separated from traffic, although riders must cross two busy streets near the market. City planners will monitor those intersections for the first three months and adjust the traffic signals if the morning queues become too long.
新修建的步行通道连接了地铁站和商业街，沿途设置了遮雨棚、长椅和无障碍坡道。市民建议在转弯处增加照明，并进一步完善指示牌。施工单位表示，将根据试运行期间收集到的意见调整细节，尽量减少对周边居民出行的影响。

This month's newsletter includes an interview with the volunteer who organizes the weekend language exchange. She explains how small groups help new participants feel comfortable and why the sessions always begin with simple introductions. The article also lists the library's upcoming workshops on public speaking, creative writing, and basic computer skills.
学校的新一期校刊介绍了学生社团在暑假期间开展的活动，包括乡村阅读推广、自然观察和校园历史资料整理。编辑部欢迎同学们提交照片和短文，但提醒投稿者注明拍摄时间、地点及作者姓名。入选作品将在下个月的展览中集中展示。

The product team decided to release the accessibility improvements before adding the new dashboard charts. Keyboard navigation and clearer focus indicators will benefit users across the entire application. The charts are still planned, but their release date depends on completing several tests with screen readers and high-contrast display settings.
设计团队重新调整了表单中的提示信息，使用户能够更容易理解哪些字段是必填项。提交失败时，页面会保留已经输入的内容，并将错误说明放在对应字段附近。下一轮测试将重点观察首次使用者能否独立完成注册，以及他们在哪些步骤停留时间较长。

According to the field notes, the first group of birds appeared near the northern shore shortly after sunrise. Observers counted them from a distance to avoid disturbing the nesting area. Because visibility decreased when the fog returned, the final count should be treated as an estimate rather than a complete record of the colony.
志愿者在湿地巡护时发现，近期迁徙的水鸟主要集中在浅水区觅食。为了减少干扰，观鸟路线将暂时避开几个重要的停留地点。工作人员提醒游客保持安静，不要投喂野生动物，并将发现的异常情况及时告知服务站。

The maintenance report lists three minor issues: a loose door handle in meeting room B, a flickering light above the stairwell, and a damaged label on the storage cabinet. None of these issues requires the office to close. Please assign a technician to inspect them before Friday and update the report after each repair is completed.
本周设备巡检发现，三号会议室的投影画面有轻微偏色，打印区的一台机器需要更换进纸滚轮。行政人员已经安排维修，并在预约系统中标注了受影响的设备。请使用者暂时选择其他会议室或打印机，以免耽误紧急工作。

The archive contains letters, notebooks, and photographs donated by families who lived in the neighborhood during the last century. Volunteers scan each item and describe its condition before placing it in a protective folder. Names are indexed separately so that visitors can search the collection without handling the original documents unnecessarily.
地方档案馆正在征集反映老街变迁的照片、票据和手写地图。工作人员会为每件捐赠物建立电子记录，并向捐赠者提供扫描副本。对于不愿永久捐出的资料，也可以预约临时借展，让更多人了解这片街区过去的生活面貌。

The delivery estimate is now between Wednesday, 14 October, and Friday, 16 October. Your order contains two packages, so the tracking page may show different arrival dates for individual items. The larger package weighs 7.5 kilograms and will require someone to be present at the delivery address to sign for it.
本次采购共包含二十四台显示器、十二个扩展坞和四十八根连接线。供应商预计在十月二十一日前完成首批发货，剩余配件将在三天后补齐。请收货部门逐箱核对数量，并在验收记录中注明型号、序列号及任何可见的外观损伤。

During the interview, the candidate described a project that initially failed because the requirements were unclear. Rather than rewriting the entire system immediately, her team interviewed the users and identified two assumptions that had caused most of the confusion. A smaller revision solved the main problem and made later improvements easier to evaluate.
在项目复盘会上，负责人承认早期计划低估了数据清理所需的时间。团队随后将任务拆分为多个可以独立验收的小阶段，并为每个阶段明确了完成标准。这样的调整没有立即缩短工期，却让进度更加透明，也减少了后续反复修改的次数。

The camping guide recommends choosing a level site away from narrow drainage channels. Even a small amount of rain upstream can send water through an otherwise dry area. Before leaving in the morning, check the ground for small pieces of packaging and make sure that every tent peg has been collected.
登山活动将在天气稳定的情况下进行，领队会在出发前再次确认路线和返程时间。参加者应携带饮水、雨具和备用衣物，并根据个人体力选择合适的队伍。沿途如果感到不适，请及时告知同伴，不要为了赶上前方队伍而勉强加速。

The reading group did not agree on the ending of the novel. Some members felt that the narrator had finally understood her own mistakes, while others thought she was still avoiding the most difficult question. The discussion became more interesting when someone pointed out a small detail from the first chapter that everyone else had forgotten.
读书会上，大家对主人公最后的选择产生了不同看法。有人认为他终于学会承担责任，也有人觉得这个结尾留下了太多没有解释的矛盾。主持人没有急着给出答案，而是请每个人回到具体段落，说明自己的判断来自哪些文字细节。

The laboratory's new booking system allows users to reserve equipment in thirty-minute intervals. Reservations longer than four hours require a brief explanation so that the coordinator can check whether other projects will be affected. If an experiment finishes early, please release the remaining time instead of leaving the reservation active until its scheduled end.
共享工作室将启用新的预约规则，每个账户每天最多预约两个时段。临时取消的名额会自动向候补名单中的用户开放，系统按登记顺序发送通知。为了提高场地利用率，连续三次预约后未到场的账户将暂停预约权限一周。

The report distinguishes between a temporary delay and a permanent reduction in capacity. Several machines were unavailable during the inspection, but all of them returned to service after routine adjustments. Comparing only the first and last day of the month would therefore give a misleading impression of the factory's normal operating conditions.
分析报告指出，不能仅根据某一天的访问量判断新功能是否受到欢迎。节假日、宣传活动和系统维护都会影响短期数据。团队建议观察至少四周，并同时比较使用频率、完成率和用户反馈，以避免将偶然波动误认为长期趋势。

Before publishing the guide, check that every screenshot matches the current interface and that all links open the intended pages. Several button names changed during the final review, so the older captions may no longer be accurate. Keep the examples short enough for a first-time user to follow without needing to read a separate reference manual.
编写操作手册时，请先说明用户需要完成的任务，再介绍具体按钮的位置。对于容易混淆的概念，可以使用简短示例帮助理解，但不要在同一段落中引入过多术语。所有截图应来自当前版本，并在发布前检查链接、编号和目录是否一致。

The ferry captain announced that the crossing would take longer because the vessel needed to avoid a patch of heavy fog. Passengers were asked to remain inside until the crew had secured the outer deck. A child near the window tried to spot the lighthouse, but its beam appeared only briefly through the gray air.
渡船离开码头时，远处的山还笼罩在薄雾中。几位乘客坐在窗边，低声讨论下午的行程。船员走过来提醒大家收好随身物品，因为前方水面可能有些颠簸。过了十几分钟，阳光突然从云层之间照下来，河面像撒了一层碎银。

The gardening club will distribute seeds at the community center on Saturday afternoon. Members are encouraged to exchange notes about which plants grew well in shaded balconies and which needed more direct sunlight. The organizers ask everyone to bring clean, clearly labeled envelopes so that the seed varieties do not become mixed together.
阳台种植小组计划在周末举办一次幼苗交换活动，参与者可以带来自己培育的香草、花卉或蔬菜苗。每盆植物最好附上名称和简单的养护说明。组织者提醒大家检查叶片是否健康，并尽量使用能够重复利用的容器，减少一次性塑料包装。

The team restored yesterday's configuration after discovering that a recent change caused several background jobs to restart repeatedly. No customer files were lost, and the delayed jobs are now being processed in their original order. Engineers are reproducing the failure in a separate environment before deciding when to try the revised configuration again.
运维人员在例行检查中发现，一项后台任务意外占用了过多连接，导致部分页面响应变慢。团队暂时降低了任务并发数，并确认用户提交的数据没有丢失。目前服务已经恢复，后续将通过模拟高负载场景验证修复效果。

The editor asked the writer to remove several dramatic claims from the introduction because the available evidence did not support them. The revised article now explains what the study actually measured and which questions remain unanswered. This made the headline less striking, but it also made the overall argument clearer and more credible.
编辑建议作者在报道中区分已经确认的事实与受访者的个人判断。对于缺乏直接证据的说法，应明确说明信息来源及其局限。修改后的文章虽然减少了几个吸引眼球的句子，但读者能够更清楚地理解事件经过，以及目前仍然存在的疑问。

The school orchestra rehearsed the final movement three times before the conductor was satisfied with the balance between the strings and the brass. She asked the players to listen across the room instead of focusing only on their own notes. By the last attempt, the quiet passage sounded more connected, and the final chord arrived without hesitation.
合唱团在正式演出前重新练习了第二段的换气位置。指挥提醒大家，不要只关注自己的音量，还要听清身旁声部的旋律。经过几次调整，原本略显生硬的转折自然了许多，结尾处的轻声也能够保持完整的层次。

Please keep the following identifiers unchanged when translating the surrounding explanation: project_alpha, build-2026.09, and /data/archive. The first identifier is a project name, the second refers to a release, and the third is a directory path. These values appear in automated checks, so changing their spelling would make the instructions difficult to follow.
以下说明涉及三个固定标识：user_id、session_timeout 和 report_2026.csv。请保留这些标识的拼写，其他内容正常翻译。user_id 用于识别用户，session_timeout 表示会话等待时间，report_2026.csv 则是导出文件的名称。请不要将文件扩展名改为大写。

The workshop ended with a practical exercise. Each group received the same complicated instruction and had to rewrite it for someone with no specialist background. The most successful version did not simply replace long words with short ones; it reorganized the information so that the reader could understand the purpose before following the individual steps.
培训最后安排了一项练习：各组需要把一段复杂说明改写成新同事能够直接使用的操作指南。表现最好的小组并没有简单删掉专业词汇，而是重新整理了信息顺序，先交代任务目的，再解释准备工作和具体步骤，让读者能够逐步建立理解。
